meta.title: Chinese serif fonts
meta.description: Adds a Chinese serif font switch under Settings → General with coarse per-region toggles: the sidebar, conversation and composer areas are detected from the live slot registry, and areas contributed by other plugins are labelled with their source. When on, Chinese text uses a serif face (Noto Serif CJK SC or another installed CJK serif) while Latin text keeps the current fonts and code stays monospaced. Requires an installed CJK serif font.
